in_memory_fake_sqlite.note: In-memory fake scales with RAM; feasible only at the low end, fails by design at enterprise scale.

note_full_restore_ephemeral: full_restore (pg_restore) and ephemeral_container are members of the 'materialize the full dataset' family: their per-cycle cost tracks fresh_fixture (rebuild/reload) and rises with size. At cloud scale full_restore additionally requires a client-side dump transfer and ephemeral_container requires local Docker + disk, so neither scales from a client past a few GB.
